content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the CSIR NEERI Project Associate-I Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 30-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CSIR NEERI to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CSIR NEERI recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Project Associate-I position at CSIR NEERI is 30 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Associate-I post under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Tech or B.E. degree in Electronics & Communication, Civil, Environmental Engineering, Mechanical, or Material Science from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Associate-I position is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category of candidates for the CSIR NEERI Project Associate-I recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for CSIR NEERI?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate-I position consists of an Online Interview conducted by the institute.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 31,000/- + HRA or Rs. 25,000/- + HRA, depending on the specific project requirements.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job location for the Project Associate-I position is Nagpur, Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is strictly online through the official website of CSIR NEERI.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the Project Associate-I position is a contractual job type under the CSIR NEERI research projects.
